Extract Article-Aligned Variance Decomposition Results

Source: R/extractors.R
variance_decomposition.Rd

Summarizes separate latent diagnostics and probability-scale Estimands A, A*, and B. No legacy 0.3.0 quantity is silently reinterpreted.

Usage

variance_decomposition(fit, prob = 0.95, print = FALSE)

Arguments

fit

A versioned bhf_fit object with schema 0.5.0.

prob

Credible-interval probability.

print

Retained transition argument. If TRUE, prints the tidy table.

Value

A bhf_variance_decomposition list with latent, A, A_star, B, gaps, and summary_table components. A_star$available is FALSE when de-attenuation was disabled.

Details

Estimands A, A*, and B are probability-scale decompositions; latent-scale SDs, variances, and ICCs are reported separately. A* treats sampling variances as fixed inputs and does not propagate their estimation uncertainty. Intervals are pseudo-posterior credible intervals. Repeated- sample coverage has been measured only in a reduced balanced synthetic design and is not guaranteed more generally.
